data: What is the approximate value of the blue line at 10000 batches?

The blue line represents the overall loss L of R2A on the source development set during training. The x-axis shows the number of batches, and the y-axis shows the loss value. At approximately 10000 batches, the blue line appears to be around 0.75. Therefore, the approximate value of the blue line at 10000 batches is 0.75.
